mapper.sql: id, device_code, name, product_id, device_type, protocol, protocol_device_id, station_id, parent_id, state, enabled, allow_simulate, allow_work, derive_metadata::text as derive_metadata, configuration::text as configuration, scene_anchor::text as scene_anchor, session_id, last_seen, online_at, registry_time, remark, created_at, updated_at

where.if: and ( lower(d.device_code) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or lower(d.name) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or lower(d.protocol_device_id) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )

mapper.select: select from pep_domain.device_instance order by id
select from pep_domain.device_instance where station_id = #{stationId} order by id
select from pep_domain.device_instance where product_id = #{productId} order by id
select from pep_domain.device_instance where device_type = #{deviceType} order by id
select count(*) from pep_domain.device_instance where product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: update pep_domain.device_instance set state = 'OFFLINE', session_id = null, updated_at = #{now} where session_id = 'gateway-telemetry' and state in ('ONLINE', 'FAULT') and last_seen < #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_domain.device_instance (device_code, name, product_id, device_type, protocol, protocol_device_id, station_id, parent_id, state, enabled, allow_simulate, allow_work, derive_metadata, configuration, scene_anchor, session_id, last_seen, online_at, registry_time, remark, created_at, updated_at) values (#{deviceCode}, #{name}, #{productId}, #{deviceType}, #{protocol}, #{protocolDeviceId}, #{stationId}, #{parentId}, #{state}, #{enabled}, #{allowSimulate}, #{allowWork}, cast(#{deriveMetadata} as jsonb), cast(#{configuration} as jsonb), cast(#{sceneAnchor} as jsonb), #{sessionId}, #{lastSeen}, #{onlineAt}, #{registryTime}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
